result.reason: The clause does not achieve either playbook position because the liability cap is not mutual. Contractor receives the greater-of-12-month-fees-or-USD-1,000,000 cap, while Company's cap remains the total fees paid, with no 12-month measurement or USD 1,000,000 floor. The carve-outs are otherwise mutual and include all preferred categories, and Company's payment obligations are appropriately excluded from damages. The mutual consequential-damages exclusion is preserved. Drafting quality is reduced by the substantive cap asymmetry, the misleading margin comment, and the uncorrected “COMPANYS'” error.
